title: Iran in ‘advanced stages’ of plots to kill U.S. officials abroad, memo warns - The Washington Post
description: Jay Clayton, the top U.S. intelligence official, said in the memo that Iran has « substantially increased » efforts to target Americans.

title: UFC 333: Alexander Volkanovski stops Movsar Evloev for record with ninth featherweight title win - BBC
description: Alexander Volkanovski strengthens his claim as the greatest featherweight of all time as he defeated Movsar Evloev inside two rounds at UFC 333 in Abu Dhabi.
